source: MAFF / ADB, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Bean crop — mung bean and black gram], official cultivation manual, 2005 (mung bean sections)
text: For mung bean specifically, the manual profiles named varieties in the "KK" series (KK1 through KK6, per the source), giving each variety's general characteristics as a basis for farmer selection. Sowing method guidance (row sowing and other methods covered jointly with black gram) and basal/top-dress fertilizer rates are given, distinguishing mung bean's rate recommendations from black gram's where the two differ.
